task.instruction: Locate the most recent research paper about 'Algebraic Topology' under Mathematics published on ArXiv. Provide the title of the paper, the name of the authors, and the abstract.

final_answer:
The most recent paper in the latest math.AT new-submissions listing (Friday, 30 October 2026) is arXiv:2610.40639. I picked it because it has the highest arXiv ID among the primary math.AT new submissions. I did not read the cross-lists past the first entry, so a cross-listed paper could have a higher ID.

**Title:** Multicomplexes in Action: Strong Formality of Compact Hyperkähler Manifolds

**Authors:** Antonio Pio Contrò

**Abstract:** We show that all compact hyperkähler manifolds are bigraded strongly formal in the sense of Milivojević and Stelzig, proving that in the context of pluripotential homotopy theory they play the same role as compact Kähler manifolds in rational homotopy theory. Indeed, the main result arises from general algebraic considerations on categories of objects with more differentials, that of multicomplexes and commutative n-differential graded algebras. For them we discuss a standard model category structure, introduce a generalization of the ∂∂¯-Lemma and establish an algebraic formality theorem.

**Subjects:** Algebraic Topology (math.AT); Algebraic Geometry (math.AG); Differential Geometry (math.DG)

**Link:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40639

judge.rationale: The page shows 26 entries incl. cross-lists, but the agent only checked 10 primary submissions and admitted a cross-list could be newer, so “most recent” wasn’t verified.
